derivation: by simpa using (Set.measurable_restrict₂_apply (s := (s : Set α)) (t := (t : Set α)) (show (s : Set α) ⊆ t from hst) hf)
explanation: The Set theorem gives measurability of the restriction along an inclusion for arbitrary sets. Specializing its sets to the coerced Finsets yields this result; the current proof instead composes with measurable_inclusion directly.
